svg.title: Stricter event definitions reduce evaluable ramp support
svg.desc: Same saved intervals, relabeled events. Tick annotations count ramp-evaluable sites and fold-condition cells with n at least 80, not all non-ramp cells. At the highest thresholds CSGS8 has no evaluable ramp cells. Coincident Condition and Rolling points are intentional.
svg.title: Stricter event definitions reduce evaluable ramp support
